Describe the expected behavior and the actual result.

Provide steps using a local fixture or a public test page. Include OS, browser commit/version, engine version, display scaling, ordinary/private profile and extension/blocking mode.

Attach sanitized logs or screenshots when appropriate. Avoid personal browsing data and credentials. Report security vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md.
